profile.headline: 🚀Sr. Software Engineer, ML @ ALSO | Ex-Samsung | Data and On-device AI | Machine Learning | GenAI | LLMs · Vision-Language Models |
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, ML and Data
profile.summary:
🚀 Sr. Machine Learning Engineer · Edge & On-Device AI:

I build AI systems that run where the data actually lives — on wearables, phones, and edge devices — turning cutting-edge work in 3D computer vision, LLMs and Vision-language models into products that work in real time.
 
I'm a senior software professional with 6 years of experience across Software, Machine Learning and Data Science, driven by a genuine passion for engineering and problem-solving. That curiosity led me to pursue Master of Engineering in Robotics from the University of Maryland, where I deepened my expertise in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, GenAI, and LLMs — and I've been building at the intersection of research and production ever since.

🧠 What I do
 I move fluidly between applied research, model fine-tuning, and production engineering — with a focus on efficient, real-time inference on resource-constrained hardware devices.

🛠️ Technical Skills
 ▪️ Languages:  Python, C++, C, Java, SQL
 ▪️ ML / GenAI:  PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, LLMs & VLMs, RAG, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ollama, Vector-databases, Agentic-frameworks, Scikit-learn, SparkML
 ▪️ Data & Analytics: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Databricks, Apache PySpark, Tableau, Power BI, Excel
 ▪️ Computer Vision & Robotics: OpenCV, Point Cloud Library(PCL), ROS, MATLAB, RViz.
 ▪️ Cloud & MLOps: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins, Travis), Git, CMake, Agile
 ▪️  Software Development: Git Version Control, CMake, Bazel, Android Development, Valgrind

 
🌟 Beyond the tech
 Organized, collaborative, and relentlessly curious — I like hard problems and shipping things that work.
 
📫 Let's connect
 Currently exploring Senior ML / AI Engineer and Applied Scientist roles across the US — especially with teams building reliable and scalable ML solutions, multimodal AI, or edge/on-device intelligence.
 📧 nakulp123@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML and Data
positions.description: Skills: Machine Learning Algorithms · Data Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Feature Engineering · Google BigQuery · Snowflake Cloud · Google Data Studio · Google Data Agent Kit

positions.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer ll
positions.description:
Classified Project:
•  Instrumented end-to-end gesture detection using IMU data and Random Forest classifier (94% accuracy) to identify user intent based on touch-input.
•   Developed a multi-modal sensor fusion algorithm syncing an Android app with wearables and XR hardware sensors, mapping raw spatial telemetry data to real-time player metrics and automated coaching strategy engines.
•  Enforced MLOps practices with automated CI/CD pipelines for in-house Multi-Sense-Vision model retraining and validation, integrating continuous drift detection and system health monitoring frameworks that reduced deployment latency by 30%.
•  Operationalized camera intrinsics estimation using SOTA Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) model inference to estimate any unknown camera’s characteristics for downstream perception tasks.
•  Engineered a synthetic video conversion tool to transform open-source video to the target-camera video with known camera intrinsics, successfully augmenting scarce training datasets and performing ablation for downstream production ML models on target XR device.
Internal Tools:
•  Architected an enterprise RAG framework using Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and Elasticsearch, improving semantic search relevance by 35% while slashing lookup latency by 40%.

positions.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer l
positions.description:
GalaxyXR Project:
•  Optimized an Android edge-device depth-estimation model via TFLite GPU delegate, driving an 70% lift in model inference speed.
•  Deployed a XGBoost Gradient-boosting classifier trained on XR telemetry (gaze duration, head movements) data, yielding 20% growth in user engagement for Extended Reality (GalaxyXR) devices.
•  Integrated a real-time head-pose prediction module in main passthrough pipeline using Planar Reprojection and Depth Reprojection algorithms that decreased latency in frame rendering by 30%.
•  Enhanced image rendering pipeline by integrating image undistortion shaders (Vulkan Graphics), improving rendering speed by 80%.

positions.title: Data Scientist II
positions.description:
•	Cooperated with data analysts, data engineers and software engineers to design data architecture requirements and deliver successful pipeline changes with 30% increase in efficiency of data storage and retrieval.
•	Built and validated a personalized investment recommendation engine using collaborative filtering and AWS SageMaker, driving a 45% increase in user portfolio adoption, verified through A/B testing.
•      Reduced excess inventory costs by $85k by deploying an ARIMA-based demand forecasting pipeline that significantly outperformed legacy baselines.
•       Segmented user investment behaviors using Chi-square and ANOVA diagnostics, enabling targeted engagement strategies that increased client conversion by 15%.
•	Modeled an efficient data pipeline using Google BigQuery; reducing data processing time by 40% providing ad-hoc querying with SQL.
•	Deployed various ML models (Multi-class Regression, Random Forest Classifier and Gradient Boosted Tree Model) on AWS Sagemaker.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · Machine Learning · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · XGBoost · Data Science · Regression Analysis · A/B Testing · Statistics · Collaborative Problem Solving · NumPy · SciPy · Pandas (Software)

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
•	Trained a real-time Classification model(Siamese Neural Network) for classifying day & night-time images of city streets with accuracy of 93% thus, enhancing Visual Positioning System for an AR app built by the company.
•	Optimized Ray-casting algorithm for rendering 3D objects in Augmented Reality(AR) app using Axis-aligned Bounding Box (AABB) tree data structure of CGAL library.  Achieved ray intersection with 3D mesh geometry of 100k triangles in 0.5 sec, improving the execution speed by 60%.
•	Engineered a scalable Python FastAPI backend with Protocol Buffers to process 1.2M+ AI metadata records using Azure Stream Analytics.
•       Maintained critical evaluations metrics (F1-score, precision, recall, confusion matrix, ROC curve) using MLFlow to monitor production models for data drift detection and documented experimental outcomes for collaborating with data labelling team.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning · PyTorch · MLOps · Computer Vision · MLflow · API Development · Production ML · OpenCV · NumPy · Matplotlib · Tensorflow · Supervised Learning

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
•	Devised object tracking in live video-feed from vehicle's on-board camera using YOLO Object Detection model, that helped in tracking fruits/vegetables of interest, reducing the model's memory footprint by 40% while maintaining a 0.88 mAP for localized fruit/vegetable tracking.
•      Trained a Retinanet CNN model with ResNet50FPN backbone for semantic image segmentation using Nvidia’s Object Detection Toolkit and Pytorch; achieved precision (mAP) of 0.90 and recall (mAR) of 0.82 across the 7 class labels of our dataset.
•      Deployed deep learning models YOLO-V3 and Faster RCNN using Docker for object detection/tracking on Nvidia Jetson TX2.
•    Enforced MLOps practice to log ML model life-cycle using MLFlow and track the evaluation metrics(Test accuracy, F1-score, Precision and Recall) and model's parameters for each training epochs.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Computer Vision · Machine Learning · PyTorch · Software Development · Deep Learning · Docker · On-Device AI · OpenCV · NumPy · Matplotlib · MLOps

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
•	Participated in Autonomous Micro Aerial Vehicle team under the supervision of Dr. Derek Paley to build an autonomous quadrotor for performing pick-up and delivery of a package against obstacles and other challenges.
•	Improved perception algorithms for AR-Tag detection and image segmentation.
•	Collaborated with team to develop autonomy/navigation algorithms for maneuvering and controlling the pose of drone.
•	Software Stack: ROS, C++, Python, MAVROS, Odroid, Pixhawk.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• I was a Teaching Assistant for the course ENPM667: Controls of Robotics System, under the guidance of Dr. Waseem Malik. 
• Assisted the professor to create and grade the assignments as well as projects.
• Held weekly office hours to resolve students' queries.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description:
•  Implemented sensor-fusion algorithms for stereo camera, GPS and IMU; interpolated the GPS data and IMU data according to the camera frame-rate. Tech-stack: Adafruit Ultimate GPS board with Raspberry Pi microcontroller for interfacing with on-board device.
•  Analyzed and trained deep learning models like YOLO-V3, Deep-sort and Faster RCNN (Convolutional  Neural Network) for object detection and tracking on Nvidia Jetson TX2.
•  Developed a depth estimation algorithm with OpenCV and C++, and integrated it with the object detection model, to measure distance of objects from camera. 
•   Employed ROS(Robot Operating System) to visualize and save disparity map from stereo images and PCL (Point Cloud Library) for visualizing the 3D point cloud.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · PyTorch · Python · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Sensor Fusion · Point Cloud Library (PCL) · OpenCV

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
•   Developed major functionalities of a cross-platform app using Xamarin Cross Platform, C#,  Agile Software Development, Version Control(Git, SVN), CI/CD(Jenkins), Unit testing, HTML, CSS, Oracle RDBMS, MySQL, JIRA(Issue and project tracking web application). Worked closely with team members in timely and efficient way for successful delivery of the app.
•    Developed data-driven solutions using Python, Apache Spark and AWS (Redshift, S3) to automate the data ingestion, feature pipelines, data extraction and migration to data servers on cloud platform, yielding increment of data migration speed by 30%.
•    Reduced Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) by 25% for sales forecasts by engineering a distributed time-series forecasting   pipeline using SparkSQL and Python.
•    Automated data validation frameworks that slashed data errors by 40%, significantly strengthening risk mitigation.
•    Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and accordingly build/deploy predictive models into production environments using AWS services (EC2, Lambda, S3, Redshift).
•     Proficiently managed large-scale datasets for predictive analytics using distributed data-processing tools like PySpark and Hadoop achieving 3x faster data processing, reduced latency and improved scalability.
 •     Contributed to a console-based networking application using Python, MySQL, Apache-Tomcat Server and Oracle database (Oracle RDBMS).
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Data Analytics · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Tableau · Data Visualization · API Development · Version Control · Database Management System (DBMS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Back-End Web Development · PySpark · Apache Spark · Amazon EC2 · AWS Lambda · Amazon S3

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description:
•  I developed 3D CAD design for chemical process equipments such as boilers, condensors, reactors, storage tanks, distillation columns and other industrial equipments based on client's requirement.
•  I performed various machining processes namely milling, drilling, welding and grinding to manufacture the equipments as per design.

honors.description: Received Gold Medal at Gujarat Technological University, for securing highest CPI-8.56/10.00 in B.E. Mechatronics Engineering(2012-2016).
